claims.quote: The destroyer swung to the southward, showing her stern to the battle-ship, and increasing her speed as the engine-room staff nursed the oil feed and the turbines.
Casey's at the receiver, still listening, but I made out only a few words like 'Charleston,' 'Brooklyn,' 'jail,' 'pirates,' 'Pensacola,' and one phrasing 'Send in pursuit.'
claims.description: Warships carry a wireless room with dedicated radio operators, and shore stations and fleets coordinate a pursuit by radio.

claims.quote: I heard him before I saw him.
claims.description: Ship-to-ship radio lets one ship hear and challenge another before it comes into sight.
